page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-30-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 30 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 15 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 120 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled as two local NVMe SSDs totaling 804 GB, while no GPU accelerators are present.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core CPU performance and high memory scores, placing in the top 25% of tested instances. Text processing and text generation for small language models also register in the upper tier. However, multi-core CPU performance, database operations, and static web serving throughput remain in the average range. A notable hardware tradeoff is the large-block uncached memory write bandwidth, which registers in the bottom 25% of benchmarks.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and fast local NVMe storage, this instance delivers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring low-latency local disk access without the premium of memory-optimized tiers. It is suited for database operations, text processing, software compilation, and small-to-medium language model inference.
